review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're hiring a Full-Stack Engineer — ExpatReady Help build the operating system for the global immigration industry - AI-native, from the foundation up. Location : Remote, based in India, with daily overlap into Canadian business hours Compensation : 12 Lacs to 18 Lacs per annum Additional: A Canadian PR / sponsorship pathway is available for the right candidate ABOUT US ExpatReady is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for immigration firms, covering the full client journey: lead, assessment, consult, retainer, payment, case delivery, and client portal. We are launching with Canadian immigration and building toward a global platform, where each new country is configurable data rather than a new build. The architecture and foundational requirements are locked and in active development. THE ROLE You will own significant surface area across the stack, including backend services, data modeling, and frontend, building the platform from its foundation. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with direct influence over architecture and product decisions. You will work closely with the Founder, CTO, and Lead Developer: A multi-tenant platform with strict tenant isolation (PostgreSQL Row-Level Security), a canonical data spine, and configuration-as-data In-house native tools, including document assembly, form-fill, and reporting Country-pack machinery, including questionnaires, document-requirement engines, government-form field maps, and eligibility scoring, Autofill functionality Three consoles: a Super-Admin control plane, the Agent (firm-staff) application, and the Client Portal A later-stage AI companion layer (agents, tool use, retrieval) built on top of the platform TECH STACK Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL (with Row-Level Security), Redis and BullMQ, S3, AWS (ca-central-1), React 19, Vite, Refine, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS. The system is structured as a modular monolith within a monorepo, with event-driven internal architecture. REQUIREMENTS 5+ years of experience shipping production full-stack web applications, with real ownership of both backend and frontend Strong TypeScript skills end-to-end, with hands-on experience in NestJS (or a comparable Node framework), Prisma or TypeORM, and PostgreSQL Senior-level React experience (hooks, data-fetching patterns, component architecture) Experience building or maintaining a multi-tenant SaaS product, with a solid understanding of tenant isolation and RBAC Regular use of AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) in your daily workflow, with the ability to review and verify AI-generated output Strong fundamentals in data modeling, API design, authentication, asynchronous processing, and testing Ability to work full-time, remote from India, with daily overlap into Canadian business hours Excellent written English and strong self-directed, asynchronous communication skills WHAT WE OFFER A Canadian PR / sponsorship pathway Competitive compensation for a senior remote role, with additional upside as the company grows A remote-first position, based anywhere in India, on a Canadian-hours schedule HOW TO APPLY Please send: Your resume or LinkedIn profile, and GitHub or code samples A brief description of the most complex multi-tenant or full-stack system you have built, including your role, the technology stack, and the most difficult part of the work An explanation of how you use AI tools in your daily coding workflow, including a concrete example and how you maintain code quality Your notice period and your availability for a Canadian-hours schedule Our process: a short introductory call, followed by a paid or live technical exercise, followed by a working session with the team. Email: ranan@expatready.com #Hiring #FullStackEngineer #RemoteJobs #NodeJS #TypeScript #React #NestJS #PostgreSQL #StartupJobs #ImmigrationTech #SaaS #IndiaJobs

review_candidates.title: Frontend Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role: Frontend Engineer Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-time Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Indicative range: $95,000 – $160,000 (USD equivalent), plus benefits. Role Overview We are hiring a Frontend Engineer to build accessible, performant, and beautiful interfaces. The role partners with design and product to translate ideas into shipped UI — the surface customers actually touch. Key Responsibilities - Build user interfaces in React, Vue, or similar modern framework - Translate design specs into pixel-accurate, accessible, performant code - Maintain and evolve the design system and shared component library - Optimise frontend performance, including bundle size and Core Web Vitals - Conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering practices - Partner closely with designers and product managers throughout the build cycle Required Skills and Qualifications - 3+ years building production frontend applications - Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Vue, and modern CSS - Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand, Pinia, or similar) - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and testing tools - Understanding of web performance optimisation - Strong design sensibility and care for craft What You'll Bring - Curiosity to dig into systems and turn findings into shipped improvements - Strong written communication and ability to explain technical decisions - A test-and-learn mindset; you ship fast, measure, and iterate - Comfort working asynchronously across time zones What We Offer - Fully remote, flexible work hours - Performance-based bonus structure - Annual learning & development stipend - Health and wellness benefits (varies by location) - Opportunity to work on high-scale, real-world impact projects Equal Opportunity Statement This is an equal opportunity role. Applications are welcomed from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, and demonstrated ability.
